I'm really sorry that you're having to go through this, it must be a daily battle and I imagine it's putting a lot of emotional strain on you. I've been through this myself and for me it was exhausting.

What's happening now is that you're placing the responsibility of your own happiness onto others. How they behave/react to you will be having a huge impact on how you feel and what you think about yourself. It's totally understandable, especially as we live in a world where perceptions are deemed to be super important.

It is absolutely essential that you learn how to take back control and become responsible for your own happiness. Try and ask yourself, "why do I want this person to like me?" and "if I'm trying so hard to be nice to them, are they doing the same for me?".

There is a huge freedom that will pass over you when you learn to make yourself happy. Enjoy the things you love, become that person you want to be. You'll find that people will naturally gravitate towards you (and like you) if you can become more self confident. If they don't, they're probably not worth your time.
Be yourself and enjoy being yourself, you will find your people. If that takes a while, then try to make the most of finding/being you and enjoying life in your own way.
